meta.title: About Brisk — A digital agency from Belgium
meta.description: Brisk designs and builds custom websites, webshops, software and apps. You talk to the people who build it. More than {total} projects delivered.

hero.lead: Brisk is a digital agency based in Belgium. We design and build custom websites, webshops, software and mobile apps. You talk directly to the people who build it.

manifesto.title: Three promises we keep.
manifesto.lead: No mission statement on the wall. Three commitments you can hold us to, from the first call until long after launch.

p1.rest: No themes, no page builders, no plugin that almost does what you need. Every project starts with your customer and ends in code we write ourselves, designed around the way you work.

p2.rest: If an idea won't work, you'll hear it on the first call, not on the invoice. You get honest advice, even when it means you need less than you thought.

p3.rest: Short phases, and a working version you can use before the last pixel is in place. And everything we make is yours: design, code and data.

principles.title: Five things we never let go.
principles.lead: Whatever the project is, these five hold. Alongside them runs work we actually shipped.

one.title: Understand first, then build.
one.body: Every project starts with questions, not a quote. What your customer needs to do, and what is stopping them today.

two.title: Speed is a feature.
two.body: A slow site loses customers. Every page we build is measured before it goes live, on a real phone.

three.title: Detail is not polish.
three.body: The transitions, the error message, the empty screen. The last details decide how something feels.

four.title: No noise.
four.body: One message per screen, one accent. Anything that doesn't help you understand or decide gets cut.

five.title: Yours, not ours.
five.body: Design, code and data belong to you. You can always carry on without us, though we hope you won't want to.

how.title: What a project with Brisk looks like.
how.lead: From the first call to launch: short phases, one point of contact and a scope agreed up front.

contact.title: Direct contact
contact.body: You talk to the people who build it. No account manager in between, no brief that gets passed on three times.

price.title: Clear scope per phase
price.body: Every phase has a clear scope agreed up front. You know what you are getting before you say yes.

custom.title: Custom, always
custom.body: No templates, no themes. Every screen is designed for your customer and built in code we write ourselves.
